en:
<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Tennis Pro's lab<CLT=cltMIND>...
If I'm right, then...

<CLT=cltMIND>the handcuffs that were found in the
tank came from here.

<CLT=cltMIND>And if the handcuffs came from here...
that means the culprit was here as well.

<CLT=cltMIND>They may have left a trace
of evidence...

This room...is a little different from when we
were here before. It feels...off.
What's the matter, Shuichi?

Ah, nothing...
Anyway, let's figure out the handcuffs.

<CLT=cltMIND>We should take care of
that problem first...
So, where should we go—
Oof!

<CLT=cltMIND>As he came out of the shower room,
Kaito tripped and fell to the ground.
The hell!? Something's caught on my leg!
Ah, it looks like a cable...

Is this for the tennis net? Man, whoever 
left this here shoulda put it in the corner.
<CLT=cltMIND>
<CLT=cltMIND>Wait... The tennis net?

I see...
So that's why this room felt odd.
<CLT=cltMIND>I should investigate this in detail.

So you think the handcuffs in the tank 
were from here, right?
Let's check it out.

Someone shoulda moved that to the corner.
It's dangerous just lying there...

I can't believe <CLT=cltSTRONG>the famous<CLT=cltNORMAL> Ryoma Hoshi was
wandering around with no will to live...

It pissed me off so much, I ended up 
being too hard on him.

But regretting that now won't help.
There's nothing I can do...

<CLT=cltMIND>I think there are still things
to investigate here...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltMIND>I think there are still things
to investigate here...

The reason I thought this room felt off
is because of the net.

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason I thought this room felt off 
is because of the net.

<CLT=cltMIND>Was it like this the last
time I came here...?

Kaito...you said that this cable is for
hanging up the tennis net, right?
Yeah, that's right...
It's the cable that keeps the net up.

That's it. The reason I thought this room felt
off is because of the net.

When I came here last time, the tennis
net was up.
But now, the cable has been removed.

So, like, someone took the cable off?
Why would they do that?
Kaito, can you help me?
I want to measure how long this cable is.
No need. It's just about 50 feet long.
...What?

Oh, I was in the tennis club till middle school,
so I know how long the cable is.
You were in the tennis club?

That's why...it pissed me off so much
that Ryoma was acting like that...
Did you...know Ryoma from before?
I never met him, but I heard a lot about him.

I mean, these days, there's no one who's 
played tennis that hasn't heard of him.

He's been a tennis legend since middle school.
He was like a hero to every tennis kid.

And then...once I finally got to meet him,
he became a coward...

That pissed me off so much, I ended up
being too hard on him.

But regretting that now won't help.
There's nothing I can do...

So what's suspicious about the length of the 
cable? Did something about it bother you?
No, nothing specific... I was just checking.

Hmm, so detectives get bothered 
by small details, huh?

Like an overbearing mother-in-law
nitpicking a young wife!
What is *that* analogy?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Tennis Net Cable<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>This cable is used to hang up the tennis
net. But because it was removed...
<CLT=cltMIND>the net is just lying on the floor.

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason I thought this room felt off 
is because of the net.

<CLT=cltMIND>The last time I was here,
the net was hung up.

<CLT=cltMIND>But now the cable is removed...
and someone intentionally removed it.
<CLT=cltMIND>But why would they do that?

<CLT=cltMIND>So the cable is about 50 feet long.
I'll make sure to remember that.

<CLT=cltMIND>Alright...I've searched the whole area now.
I should move on to the next one.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are still other places
left to search.
